name: oc-be-tools
description: Backend development toolkit for Opencell Core — agents for building entities, services, APIs, tests, and Postman collections, guideline-loading skills, an implementation orchestrator (/oc-be-implement) whose sub-agents record file manifests, a guideline-based code review command (/oc-be-review) with a SonarQube quality-gate summary that tags the ticket ai_code_review_back, and an AI-usage estimator (/oc-be-calculate-ai-use) with per-category line/contribution/retention breakdowns, unit-test and Postman assertion counts, first-pass-vs-fix provenance, a planning/analysis effort axis, and ai_Dev_back / ai_test_back_dev Jira tagging
